title: Table
description: Table YAML schema v2 for s3.chedaws.io/v1 Table. metadata.namespace and metadata.name are identity fields that determine the S3 prefix and Glue catalog resources. spec.producer is optional; when present, an additional table-scoped IAM role is provisioned. spec.schema is optional; when present, a Glue database (edp_<env>_<namespace>) and table (<name>) are provisioned.

namespace.description: Namespace identifier. Must match the parent directory name under s3/. Hyphens are normalised to underscores in the Glue database name only.

name.description: Table/dataset identifier. Lowercase, underscores only (no hyphens). Must match the YAML file stem. Used as-is for the Glue table name, S3 prefix segment, and IAM role name segment.

owner.description: Team slug responsible for this dataset

format.description: File format for data objects landing in this dataset's S3 prefix

producer.description: Optional. When present, provisions an additional table-scoped IAM role with s3:PutObject scoped to <namespace>/<name>/*.

environments.description: Environments where this table-level role is active. At least one environment must be declared.

^(dev|test|uat|prod)$.description: IAM identity for this table-scoped role in the named environment. Exactly one of iamRoles or certificateSubject must be present.

iamRoles.description: IAM role ARNs that will assume the EDP table-scoped producer role

certificateSubject.description: Certificate CN values for IAM Roles Anywhere trust (on-premises producers).

schema.description: Optional schema declaration. When present, a Glue database (edp_<env>_<namespace>) and table (<name>) are provisioned.

columns.description: Ordered list of column definitions for the Glue table

type.description:
Glue-native column type. Primitives: boolean, tinyint, smallint, int, bigint, float, double, decimal[(

,)], string, varchar[()], char[()], binary, date, timestamp. Complex: array, map, struct, uniontype.

comment.description: Optional column description shown in Glue and Athena

partitionKeys.description: Column names to use as Hive partition keys. Must be a subset of columns[].name values.

decommission.description: Two-phase decommission guard. Set true and merge before deleting the YAML file. When true, the table-level IAM role (if any) and Glue resources for this dataset are destroyed.
